title: 第19章 向女帝下战书第20章 战书变情书
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 略施小计，叶轩便成功接近叶家七个没长脑子的女人。
隨后在叶灵儿、叶寒、叶清清等人的引荐下，顺利进入叶家。
按照早已制定好的计划，某日在丹老的帮助下，叶轩“不经意间”在叶鼎和叶家老祖面前展露身怀无上神体，有大帝之姿的“秘密”。
那一日，地涌金莲，仙音渺渺，紫霞横铺三万里
引发各种天地异象，把叶家老祖和叶家家主惊得下巴都掉了，只以为叶家又捡到宝了。
在叶鼎激动地直哆嗦时，白莲叶轩想起前世看过的电视剧中的某个情节，脑瓜子一热。
当著眾人的面，顺势跪在叶鼎面前，声泪俱下喊出了那句：
“叶叔，我听说您儿子废了，我父母死得也早。”
“如果您不嫌弃的话，我想给您养老！我想带领整个叶家走向辉煌！走向巔峰！把所有圣地和不朽世家踩在脚底下，让叶家成为荒古大陆第一大世家！”
叶鼎愣了半晌后，感动得只抹眼泪。
反正楚尘已经被废了，叶家眼瞅著即將衰落下去，如今来了个拥有大帝之姿的叶轩，那不是上天眷顾叶家是什么？
於是乎，叶轩顺利成为叶鼎的养子。
进而一步步取代被废的楚尘，成为叶家未来的希望！
计划进行得很顺利，楚尘这个气运之子，妥妥的小说主角，在穿越者、大反派叶轩面前，被全方位吊打。
叶轩用尽从蓝星上学来的《孙子兵法、《三十六计等等，暗中推波助澜，使袢子，立白莲人设的同时，各种打压、欺骗、诬陷楚尘，顺利离间楚尘和叶家人的关係。
直至把楚尘的圣子之位剥夺，夺走属於楚尘的资源、气运、奇遇
甚至还包括亲情！！
只是叶轩怎么也没想到，楚尘会这么强硬，或者说
破罐子破摔更合適些。
不过是要剥夺楚尘的圣子之位，谁料到楚尘直接断绝跟叶鼎之间的父子关係，族谱除名，叛出叶家。
楚尘的死活，叶轩根本不关心。
只是他这一走，就如叶凌月所说，叶家气运散尽，厄气丛生，连带著叶轩没有气运可掠夺，还谈什么大帝之姿？
悔之晚矣。
“操之过急！操之过急！！”
等叶轩走远后，黑色戒指內才悠悠传来丹老的一道嘆息声：
“跟楚尘身上蕴含的大气运相比，一个圣子的月俸算得了什么？”
“捡了芝麻丟西瓜，你要老夫如何说你是好！”
叶轩听后，也是肠子都悔青了。
可如今木已成舟，事情已经发生了，再后悔也没用啊。
“老师，那我该怎么办？要不离开叶家，再寻个其他不朽世家或是圣地霍霍去？”
叶轩很清楚，不掠夺他人气运，以他自己的修行天赋，一辈子都突破不了圣境，就更別说传说中的帝境了。
“莫急！莫慌！”
丹老微微嘆了一口气，沉吟片刻后，继续开口道：
content_en:
With a little trick, Ye Xuan successfully approached seven brainless women in the Ye family.
Later, with the introduction of Ye Ling'er, Ye Han, Ye Qingqing and others, he successfully entered the Ye family.
According to the long-established plan, one day, with the help of Elder Dan, Ye Xuan "inadvertently" revealed in front of Ye Ding and the ancestors of the Ye family the "secret" of possessing a supreme divine body and having the appearance of a great emperor.
On that day, golden lotuses surged from the ground, the fairy voice was faint, and purple clouds spread across thirty thousand miles.
It triggered all kinds of strange phenomena in the world, and the ancestors of the Ye family and the head of the Ye family were so shocked that their jaws dropped, thinking that the Ye family had found another treasure.
While Ye Ding was trembling with excitement, Bailian Ye Xuan thought of a certain plot in a TV series he had watched in his previous life, and his mind went crazy.
In front of everyone, he knelt down in front of Ye Ding and cried out:
"Uncle Ye, I heard that your son died, and my parents also died early."
"If you don't mind it, I want to support you in your old age! I want to lead the entire Ye family to glory! To the top! Trample all the holy places and immortal families under my feet, and make the Ye family become the largest family in the ancient continent!"
""
After Ye Ding was stunned for a long time, he was so moved that he wiped away tears.
Anyway, Chu Chen has been deposed, and the Ye family is about to decline. Now there is Ye Xuan who has the appearance of an emperor. What is this but God's blessing on the Ye family?
As a result, Ye Xuan successfully became Ye Ding's adopted son.
And step by step, he replaced the deposed Chu Chen and became the hope of the Ye family's future!
The plan went smoothly. Chu Chen, the son of fate and the proper protagonist of the novel, was beaten in all directions in front of the time traveler and villain Ye Xuan.
Ye Xuan used all the "Art of War by Sun Tzu" and "Thirty-six Stratagems" he learned from Blue Star to secretly add fuel to the flames. While setting up Bailian's character, he suppressed, deceived and framed Chu Chen in various ways, and successfully alienated the relationship between Chu Chen and the Ye family.
Until Chu Chen is deprived of his position as the Holy Son, and his resources, luck, and adventures are taken away.
Even family affection! !
But Ye Xuan never thought that Chu Chen would be so tough, or that
It is more appropriate to break the jar and smash it.
It was just to deprive Chu Chen of his position as the Holy Son. Who would have expected that Chu Chen would directly sever the father-son relationship with Ye Ding, remove his name from the family tree, and betray the Ye family.
Ye Xuan didn't care about Chu Chen's life or death at all.
But when he left, just as Ye Lingyue said, the Ye family's luck was gone and misfortune abounded. Ye Xuan also had no luck to plunder, so how could he talk about being like an emperor?
It's too late to regret.
"It's too hasty! It's too hasty!!"
After Ye Xuan walked away, a sigh from Elder Eun came from the black ring:
"Compared with Chu Chen's great fortune, what is the monthly salary of a saint?"
"If you pick up sesame seeds and throw away watermelons, what do you want me to say about you?"
After hearing this, Ye Xuan felt regretful.
But now the deal is done, things have happened, and there is no point in regretting it.
"Teacher, what should I do? How about leaving the Ye family and finding another immortal family or the Holy Land?"
Ye Xuan knew very well that if he did not plunder other people's luck, with his own cultivation talent, he would never be able to break through to the Holy Realm, let alone the legendary Imperial Realm.
"Don't be anxious! Don't panic!"
Elder Dan sighed slightly, and after pondering for a moment, he continued:
